clarifications.sparkle: Three selector roles: amount profile, main wet/dry profile, pitch wet/dry profile. No LFO.

assumptions: Select-4 1 is the amount bank, Select-4 2 the main wet/dry bank, following user clarification; UI capture alone did not identify these banks.
Uncaptured Math B baselines default to zero and are exposed as AWParams. Uncaptured mixer volume defaults to zero, also exposed.
Only cyclic edges use previous-control-block values. Bitwig feedback evaluation timing is not established.
Selector zero reserves an empty pole, as Verb; switch basePole:false to compare a four-pole interpretation.
Tool volume taper is inferred: (2 * normalized)^3. Rate factor x2.187 is interpreted exponentially as 0.04 * 2.187^Math3.
Sparkle branch outputs sum, not average. Static gains remain before/after the appropriate subrack.
No equivalence claimed for native EQ-DJ approximation, untouched hidden plugin state or host modulation clipping.
